[[File:OrdnanceProcurer-HnR.jpg|thumb|right|An ordnance procurer]]
'''Procurement and Supply''' was a branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that worked to free material from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-occupied worlds. Individuals working for Procurement and Supply included [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] [[Technicians/Legends|Technicians]] (from the [[7th Regiment]]) known as "'''Procurement Specialists'''" or "'''Scroungers'''." [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] served as a Procurement Specialist on [[Averam/Legends|Averam]] and other worlds under the alias "Targeter." Procurement specialists who specialized in acquiring ordnance were known as "'''Ordnance Procurers'''."
